AI Workflow Automation

Give each service a private URL, tell Pascal what matters, and get a summary with key facts and useful links. # Bubble app events to iPhone alerts with Pascal's Pager

If you keep opening your Bubble app just to check whether a job finished or a new account came through, this is a way to have selected events reach your own iPhone.

Disclosure: I built Pascal’s Pager, the paid iPhone app used in this example. It takes event JSON and turns it into a readable Alert, so you don’t have to build a separate notification sentence for each event.

Here’s the setup for a fictional completed export:

This is for you as the app’s operator. It isn’t a system for sending push notifications to all your Bubble users. You still choose the events and data Bubble sends.

In the app, you can configure masking before AI processing and choose how much attention each Source gets. [...] Which event would you connect first: a completed job, a new paid account, or something else?

Product and test-data demo: 

Use fictional JSON only; the website demo does not apply Source masking.
